Strategies for adjusting the assessment process
banglaExplanation: সব candidate একরকম নয়, তাই assessment process-এ কিছু adjustment করতে হয়।
বইয়ে ছয়টি ভাগ আছে: Indigenous, Age, Gender, Educational background, Disability, Low levels of literacy।
মূল কথা: job role-এর চেয়ে বেশি literacy লাগে এমন methods ব্যবহার করবেন না।
সময় বাড়ানো, ছোট ছোট assessments, support person: এগুলো candidate-এর needs মেটায়।

example.bn: বয়স্ক গার্মেন্টস কর্মী ছোট লেখা পড়তে পারেন না, তাই assessor প্রশ্ন পড়ে শোনান আর ছোট ছোট সেশন নেন।
example.en: An older garments worker cannot read small print. The assessor reads the questions aloud and uses shorter sessions.

importance.bn: Short Questions (Short 7, 9), CBT&A L4 Written Test — Inclusivity & Maintenance (MCQ 4) আর CBLM 12 Self Check 1 (Q4): 3 জায়গায় এসেছে। CBLM 12-এ highlight করা আছে। পরীক্ষায় MCQ আর short question হিসেবে আসে। অবশ্যই পড়বেন।

short.modelAnswer:
The assessor may:
1. Discuss the disability's impact with the candidate and supervisor.
2. Use methods needing no higher literacy than the job (e.g. pointing).
3. Use a support person.
4. Use short sentences.
5. Clarify by rephrasing.
6. Confirm understanding.
7. Read printed information to the candidate.
8. Use graphics, pictures and colour coding.
9. Write down oral responses.
10. Allow enough time.
11. Have shorter assessments.

realQuestions.answer:
The assessor may
•
discuss with the candidate and supervisor whether the disability is likely to impact
on the assessment process
•
use methods that do not require a higher level of language or literacy than is
required to perform the job role, for example pointing to something may meet
enterprise requirements rather than talking about it
•
use support person and other support strategies as required
•
use short sentences that do not contain large amounts of information
•
clarify information by rephrasing
•
confirm understanding, for example ask the candidate to rephrase questions
•
read any printed information to the candidate
•
use graphics, pictures and colour coding instead of, or to support, text
•
offer to write down, or have someone else write, oral responses given by the
candidate
•
ensure that the time available to complete the assessment, while meeting industry
requirements, takes account of the candidate's needs
•
have a number of shorter assessments rather than trying to cram too much into
one session
realQuestions.label: CBLM 12 Self Check 1 (Q4)
realQuestions.question:
What can an assessor do to accommodate the needs of trainees who have a
disability?

realQuestions.answer:
Any three: read printed information aloud; use a sufficiently large
font; recognise the candidate's experience; allow adequate time; or use several
shorter assessment sessions instead of one long session.
